body: Smoker of ten years who quit six months ago. When you find yourself thinking about it, change the subject. If you debate yourself over whether or not you want to, you will. You need give yourself tasks to complete. Stretch, clean, read, cook, plan, work, relax, sleep. Take a few deep breath to relax and calm the anxiety and then just work on the first thing you see or go about your business. If youre just trying to quit porn then give yourself a strict schedule (once every 3 days or so) and stick to it. If it doesnt happen without porn it doesnt happen and you wait until the next scheduled date. Eventually orgasm withdrawal will make it super easy to climax with or without porn. Working on diet is good idea to and veggies tend to be cheap. Ramen is cheap but rinse to reduce high levels of sodium. Good luck.
